name: API-Bench-TorchHub
description: A benchmark dataset that evaluates model ability to use PyTorch Hub APIs by requiring generation of correct code snippets that load models, weights, and run simple inference workflows. Tasks focus on correct API usage, argument handling, and producing functionally correct code verified by tests or execution. Intended to measure practical API-level coding competence rather than general language understanding.
evaluation_method: pass@k (functional correctness / unit-test based execution checks)
general_score_metric: pass@k / functional correctness rate (percentage of tasks passing execution-based tests)
reputation: A niche but practical benchmark for code-generation and API-usage evaluation; limited adoption outside code-generation research and toolsmithing communities.
